This migration script restores the text of the answers created before the version 2.2 of the Forum Application. That version renamed the ##answer## property of ##ForumCode.AnswerClass## to ##description## without migrating the existing answers, so their text is still stored but it is not displayed anymore. The script moves the text to the ##description## property. It can be executed before or after the 2.2.1 migration and it is safe to execute it more than once. For more details, please see: https://jira.xwiki.org/browse/XAFORUM-261. {{velocity}} #set ($answerClassName = 'ForumCode.AnswerClass') ## The 'answer' property is not part of the class anymore, so it can be found only by looking at the stored properties. #set ($legacyAnswersStatement = ", BaseObject as obj, LargeStringProperty as prop where obj.name = doc.fullName and obj.className = :className and prop.id.id = obj.id and prop.id.name = 'answer'") #set ($legacyAnswers = $services.query.hql($legacyAnswersStatement).bindValue('className', $answerClassName).addFilter('unique').execute()) #if (!$hasAdmin) {{error}}Only the administrators can execute this migration.{{/error}} #elseif (!$xcontext.hasProgrammingRights()) ## Removing a property that is not part of the class anymore is not possible through the script API. {{error}}This page needs programming rights in order to execute the migration. Please save it with a user having programming rights.{{/error}} #elseif ($legacyAnswers.isEmpty()) {{info}}There is no answer to migrate.{{/info}} #elseif ("$!request.confirm" == 'true' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.form_token)) == Result == #set ($logger = $services.logging.getLogger($doc.fullName)) #set ($discard = $logger.info('Migration of the answers text started...')) {{html clean="false"}}
